name: Kahuya
meaning_en: Name of a man, g. SivAdi.

name: Kaikeya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śibi.

name: Kaishika
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vidarbha; father of Cidi, after whom caidyas came to be known.

name: Kaitabha
meaning_en: Name of an Asura (slain by Viṣṇu).

name: Kaivalyashrama
meaning_en: Name of a pupil of Govinda (author of a Comm. on ).

name: Kaiyata
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jaiyaṭa (author of a Comm. on ).

name: Kakashirshi
meaning_en: Name of a man (probably a patronymic).

name: Kakatiyarudra
meaning_en: Name of a king of Nāgapura.

name: Kakavarnin
meaning_en: Name of a prince (or descendant of Bimbisāra).

name: Kakshaputi
meaning_en: Name of a physician (wrong for kAkzapuwi?).

name: Kaksheyu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Raudrāśva and Ghṛtācī.

name: Kakshivat
meaning_en: Name of a rājarṣi becoming a Brāhmaṇa.

name: Kakudachakra
meaning_en: Name of a brother of Vasudeva.

name: Kakudaksha
meaning_en: Name of a man g. revaty-Adi.

name: Kakupada
meaning_en: Name of a Rākṣasa in Sutalam.

name: Kakustha
meaning_en: Name of the father of Gau who was married to Yati.

name: Kakutstha
meaning_en: Name of the son of Śaśāda; rode on Indra in the form of a bull in the Āḍīvaka Yuddha.

name: Kakvala
meaning_en: Name of a man (vv.ll. kakkvala, kakvalla).

name: Kalachakshu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Anu.

name: Kaladantaka
meaning_en: Name of a Nāga (a son of Vāsuki).

name: Kalakacharya
meaning_en: Name of a Jaina teacher and astronomer.

name: Kalakendra
meaning_en: Name of a prince of the Dānavas.

name: Kalakirti
meaning_en: Name of a king identified with the Asura Suparṇa.

name: Kalanabha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Hiraṇyākṣa and Bhānū.

name: Kalanaka
meaning_en: Name of one of the attendants of Śiva.

name: Kalanala
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sabhānara and a Paṇḍita; and father of Sṛñjaya.

name: Kalanara
meaning_en: Name of a son of Sabhā-nara (a son of Anu), (cf. kAlAnala.).

name: Kalanemi
meaning_en: Name of a son of Virocana and father of four sons.

name: Kalapatha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Viśvā-mitra.

name: Kalashikantha
meaning_en: Name of a man, and pl. m. his descendants g. upakAdi.

name: Kalashodara
meaning_en: Name of an attendant in Skanda's retinue.

name: Kalashoka
meaning_en: Name of a king (probably Name of the celebrated king Candra-gupta q.v.).

name: Kalavega
meaning_en: Name of a Nāga (a son of Vāsuki).

name: Kalayani
meaning_en: Name of a teacher (a pupil of Bāṣkali).

name: Kalayavana
meaning_en: Name of a prince of the Yavanas.

name: Kaleya
meaning_en: Name of an Asura who was exhausted in Amṛtaman- thana.

name: Kalhana
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Rāja-taraṅgiṇī (often spelt kahlaṇa).

name: Kali
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Kalpa-kedāra.

name: Kalika
meaning_en: Name of a son of Maya.

name: Kalimga
meaning_en: Name of the king of, present at the marriage of Anī- ruddha and advised Rukmin to invite Rāma for dice.

name: Kalimgaka
meaning_en: Name of a Brāhmaṇa friend of Bhīṣma hailing from Kaliṅga; narrated to Bhīṣma ways by which to be free from Yama's subjection.

name: Kalin
meaning_en: Name of a son of Caidyoparicara.

name: Kaliya
meaning_en: Name of a Nāga (inhabiting the Yamunā, slain by Kṛṣṇa, also written kAlIya, ).

name: Kaliyaka
meaning_en: Name of a Nāga (different fr. Kāliya).

name: Kalki
meaning_en: Name of the tenth incarnation of Viṣṇu when he is to appear mounted on a white horse and wielding a drawn sword as destroyer of the wicked (this is to take place at the end of the four Yugas or ages).

name: Kallola
meaning_en: Name of a son of Saramā, and father of four sons.

name: Kalmashapada
meaning_en: Name of a king of Saudāsa (descendant of Ikṣvāku transformed to a Rākṣasa by Vasiṣṭha).

name: Kalodayin
meaning_en: Name of a disciple of Buddha, .

name: Kalpaka
meaning_en: Name of a tree of Indra's paradise.

name: Kalpalatavatara
meaning_en: Name of a comm. of Kṛṣṇa on the Bījagaṇita.

name: Kalpavarsha
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Vasu-deva and Upa-devā).

name: Kalyanachandra
meaning_en: Name of an astronomer in the twelfth century.

name: Kalyanasharman
meaning_en: Name of a commentator on Varāha-mihira.

name: Kamadeva
meaning_en: Name of the son of Yaśodharā (Yaśodhāri- Vā.

name: Kamagama
meaning_en: Name of gods of the eleventh epoch of Manu.

name: Kamalasaptami
meaning_en: Name of a vrata in honour of the Sun god.

name: Kamalavardhana
meaning_en: Name of a king of Kampana.

name: Kamali
meaning_en: Name of a pupil of Vaiśampāyana.

name: Kamasena
meaning_en: Name of a king of Rāmavatī.

name: Kamaviddha
meaning_en: Name of a man g. kArtakOjapAdi.

name: Kambalabarhi
meaning_en: Name of . A son of Marutta.

name: Kambalashvatara
meaning_en: Name of Nāga with the sun in the months of Māśi and Paṅguni.

name: Kambushringa
meaning_en: Name of a son of Raivata Manu.

name: Kamini
meaning_en: Name of a group of women who came from the mouth of Asura Bala when he yawned.

name: Kamka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Ugrasena.

name: Kampilya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Bhramyāśva.

name: Kamsa
meaning_en: Name of a king of Mathurā (son of Ugra-sena and cousin of the Devakī who was mother of Kṛṣṇa [Ugra-sena being brother of Devaka, who was father of Devakī]; he is usually called the uncle, but was really a cousin of Kṛṣṇa, and became his implacable enemy because it had been prophesied to Kaṃsa that he would be killed by a child of Devakī; as the foe of the deity he is identified with the Asura Kālanemi; and, as he was ultimately slain by Kṛṣṇa, the latter receives epithets like kaMsa-jit, conqueror of Kaṃsa ).

name: Kanabhuti
meaning_en: Name of a Yakṣa, (cf. a/-kARa, ekAkza, and kARUka.).

name: Kanada
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhīmaraṇa.

name: Kanakadhvaja
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

name: Kanakangada
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

name: Kanakapida
meaning_en: Name of a being attending on Skanda.

name: Kanakavarna
meaning_en: Name of a king (supposed to be a former manifestation of Śākyamuni).

name: Kanakavigraha
meaning_en: Name of a king of Viśālapurī.

name: Kanakayu
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, (v.l. karakAyu).

name: Kanakodbhava
meaning_en: Name of a son of Hṛdika.

name: Kanavaka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śūra.

name: Kanchana
meaning_en: Name of a prince, a son of Bhīma and father of Suhotra.

name: Kanchanacharya
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Dhanaṃjaya-vijaya.

name: Kanchanaprabha
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Bhīma and father of Suhotra).

name: Kandanaka
meaning_en: Name of a being attendant on Śiva.

name: Kandina
meaning_en: Name of a Vāśiṣṭha and a sage.

name: Kanishka
meaning_en: Name of a celebrated king of Northern India (whose reign began in the first century of our era and who, next to Aśoka, was the greatest supporter of Buddhism; his empire seems to have comprised Afghānistān, the Panjāb, Yarkand, Kaṣmīr, Ladak, Agra, Rājputāna, Gujarāt, and Sindh).

name: Kanishtha
meaning_en: Name of one of the five deva-gaṇas of the 14th epoch of Bhautya Manu.

name: Kanka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Ugrasena, and brother of Kaṃsa; killed by Balarāma.

name: Kanthaka
meaning_en: Name of a man g. gargAdi.

name: Kanthayanadvija
meaning_en: Name of the class of Brāhmaṇas from Me- dhātithi, son of Kaṇṭha.

name: Kanvayana
meaning_en: Name of the clan of Brāhmaṇas from Kaṇva, son of Ajamīḍha; a pravara of Aṅgiras.

name: Kanyaka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Maṇibhadra.

name: Kapatadaitya
meaning_en: Name of a Daitya, or one who pretends to be a Daitya.

name: Kapeya
meaning_en: Name of addressed Sūta to explain creation.

name: Kapi
meaning_en: Name of Asura vanquished by Kṛṣṇa.

name: Kapiladeva
meaning_en: Name of the author of a Smṛti.

name: Kapilashva
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kuvalayāśva, who survived the fire from Dhundhu's mouth.

name: Kapileya
meaning_en: Name of the Daitya-rākṣasas from the Daitya king Kumbha.

name: Kapiloma
meaning_en: Name of a son of Khaśā, and a Rākṣasa.

name: Kapisha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Danu.

name: Karabhajana
meaning_en: Name of a son of Ṛṣabha, and a bhāgavata; described the forms of Hari worshipped by men in different yugas.

name: Karalajanaka
meaning_en: Name of a prince (also called Janaka).

name: Karalayu
meaning_en: Name of a brother of Balāhaka and a commander of Bhaṇḍa; rode on preta.

name: Karambha
meaning_en: Name of the son of Śakuni.

name: Karambhi
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śakuni and father of Devarāta.

name: Karamdhama
meaning_en: Name of the son of Khaninetra.

name: Karandama
meaning_en: Name of a son of Trayīsānu and father of Marutta.

name: Karataka
meaning_en: Name of a brother of Balāhaka, and a commander of Bhaṇḍa; rode on Vetāla.

name: Karava
meaning_en: Name of a chief of the Vānaras.

name: Karburam
meaning_en: Name of the colour of the 14th Manu Sāvarṇi.

name: Kardama
meaning_en: Name of a man, a son of Kṣema-gupta.

name: Kardamaraja
meaning_en: Name of a man (a son of Kṣema-gupta).

name: Karishagandhi
meaning_en: Name of a man Comm. on.

name: Karivratam
meaning_en: Name of the performer of, becomes king.

name: Karkatya
meaning_en: Name of a man g. vAkinAdi ().

name: Karkota
meaning_en: Name of the Nāga presiding over the month of Puṣya.

name: Karmajit
meaning_en: Name of son of Bṛhatsena and father of Sṛtañjaya.

name: Karman
meaning_en: Name of a prince of Mā- lava.

name: Karmasha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Pulaha (= karma-SrezWa).

name: Karmashreshtha
meaning_en: Name of a son of Pulaha by Gati.

name: Karnikara
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jaṭāyu.

name: Kartaviryarjuna
meaning_en: Name of a prominent king of the lunar line.

name: Karttikeya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śiva and Pārvatī (popularly regarded as god of war, because he leads the Gaṇas or hosts of Śiva against the demon hosts See ; accord. to one legend he was son of Śiva without the intervention of Pārvatī, the generative energy of Śiva being cast into the fire and then received by the Ganges, whence he is sometimes described as son of Agni and Gaṅgā; when born he was fostered by the six Kṛttikās q.v., and these offering their six breasts to the child he became six-headed; he is also called Kumāra, Skanda, and Subrahmaṇya; his Name Kārttikeya may be derived from his foster mothers or from the month Kārttika as the best for warfare: in the and elsewhere he is regarded as presiding over thieves).

name: Karundhaka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śūra (and brother of Vasu-deva).

name: Karusha
meaning_en: Name of one of the ten sons of Vaivasvata Manu.

name: Karushaka
meaning_en: Name of a son of Manu Vaivasvata, (cf. above).

name: Karutthama
meaning_en: Name of a son of Duṣyanta (and father of Ākrīḍa).

name: Kashaka
meaning_en: Name of a god or demon.

name: Kashakritsna
meaning_en: Name of a man (v.l. for kASa-kftsna, q.v.) g. arIhaRAdi.

name: Kashaya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kāśa or Kāśi.

name: Kasheya
meaning_en: Name of the son of Kāśa; king of Kāsī; father of Rāṣṭra.

name: Kashin
meaning_en: Name of a man (as son of Brahman Kavi).

name: Kashipa
meaning_en: Name of a son of Kāśya.

name: Kashiya
meaning_en: Name of a prince (v.l. for kASi-rAja).

name: Kashtha
meaning_en: Name of one of Kubera's attendants.

name: Kashya
meaning_en: Name of the father of Kāśyapa and ancestor of Kāśirāja Dhan- vantari.

name: Kashyapabhaskara
meaning_en: Name of the author of a commentary called Paribhāṣābhāskara.

name: Kashyapeya
meaning_en: Name of one of the sages who heard the first part of the Purāṇa asked Sūta to speak on Pratisandhi; a gotrakara.

name: Kastambara
meaning_en: Name of a man, (pl.) his family.

name: Kata
meaning_en: Name of a Kauśika and a sage.

name: Katajaka
meaning_en: Name of a man, on Vārtt. 3, on.

name: Katha
meaning_en: Name of a sage (a pupil of Vaiśampāyana and founder of a branch of the Yajur-veda, called after him).

name: Kathajava
meaning_en: Name of a pupil of Bāṣkali.

name: Kathana
meaning_en: Name of a Rākṣasa living in Sutalam.

name: Katherani
meaning_en: Name of a man g. upakAdi.

name: Kati
meaning_en: Name of a sage (son of Viśvā-mitra and ancestor of Kātyāyana).

name: Kauberaka
meaning_en: Name of a sage living in Hariśṛṅga summoned by Āgastyas.

name: Kaumara
meaning_en: Name of came to be called after Kumāra, son of Havya; a continent with Nārada hill.

name: Kaumaram
meaning_en: Name of a varṣa noted for Kumārī tīrtham protected by Nāgas; centring round Raivata hill; after Kumāra, son of Havya.

name: Kaundinya
meaning_en: Name of a Muni or divine sage.

name: Kaushapi
meaning_en: Name of an Ārṣeya pravara of Bhārgava.

name: Kaushilya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Jaṭamāli of the 19th dvāpara.

name: Kauthuma
meaning_en: Name of a son of Parāśara, in charge of a Saṃhitā.

name: Kautilya
meaning_en: Name of the Brāhmaṇa who was responsible for van- quishing the Nandas and anointing Chandragupta Maurya.

name: Kavasha
meaning_en: Name of a sage and father of Tura.

name: Kavibhushana
meaning_en: Name of the son of Kavi-candra.

name: Kaviratha
meaning_en: Name of a prince (son of Citraratha).

name: Kavivallabha
meaning_en: Name of the son of Kavi-candra.

name: Kavya
meaning_en: Name of an Aṅgirasa, and one of the seven sages of Tāmasa Manu; a mantrakṛt.

name: Kayya
meaning_en: Name of a prince (founder of a shrine and a Vihāra called after him).

name: Kedaranatha
meaning_en: Name of Śiva as worshipped in the Himālaya.

name: Kedaresha
meaning_en: Name of a statue of Śiva in Kāśī.

name: Keli
meaning_en: Name of a son of Brahmadhāna.

name: Kenava
meaning_en: Name of a teacher (pupil of Śākapūrṇi).

name: Kerala
meaning_en: Name of a son of Āṇḍira, after whom came the Keraladeśa.

name: Kesari
meaning_en: Name of the father of Hanumat.

name: Keshavamishra
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Dvaita-pariśiṣṭa and of the Chandoga-pariśiṣṭa.
